lines: You're so late I thought you had died.
Rinka-senpai should have been holding back Akitsu and Asuka, who were after us at the behest of the masked woman.
Those two monsters are getting along well with each other. The Steel Reaper and the Demon Fist Taimanin, I mean.
And you... It's not like you came here to help us, did you?
Of course not! We're enemies right now!
Akitsu readied her six short swords, two in her own hands, and four held by the "Magick Gear" on her back.
Let go of the girl! Or I won't hesitate to slice you up too!
This time it was Hebiko who stepped in front of me.
Fuma-chan, Hebiko will stop her here.
Hehe, to be honest, Hebiko was quite moved by Shikanosuke-chan's courage. Hebiko can't lose to him!
And now that Heberybody's decided to protect that girl, she needs to be protected no matter what!
With me carrying Saya on my back, Hebiko would have to protect us as well and wouldn't be able to concentrate on the fight. Going ahead was the best choiceー
With that in mind, I left Hebiko and Akitsu behind and sprinted down the mountain path.
